n: Dagu Magician Arduino robot (Wyoming SHSI course)
t: A 27-hour summer course where students build and program Arduino robots.
steps: Find the ASEE paper by Barrett, Anderson and Love.
Read the course plan and the maze competition.
Buy one Dagu Magician kit, an Arduino UNO R3 and infrared sensors per student.
Ask IT to install the Arduino IDE.
Plan the sessions over three weeks.
Build one robot first as a test.
Set up a maze for the final competition.
